abstract: We present a nineteen-arm, three-seed (42, 101, 7) study of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on Qwen3-0.6B-Base across 64 primary training runs (3,422 steps; plus 12 external retraining runs) and 182 primary evaluations (66,142 independently regraded responses across PASS 1 and PASS 4) on GSM8K-200 + AMC23-40 (N=240), a 210-item validation split, and MATH-500. First, on the 54%–62% of steps with homogeneous binary rewards, replacing zero-advantage backward passes with O(P) zero-gradient AdamW updates is bitwise equivalent on any fixed trajectory while cutting analytical output FLOPs by 43.2% (3.5% same-host wall-clock reduction). Second, in two-stage (4x2) rollouts, an F_t-measurable stopped tree preserving sampling marginals contrasts with outcome-dependent root-restart sampling. In a 2x2 (512 vs. 1,024 tokens x beta = 0.0 vs. 0.25) stopped-tree factorial (Arms 5, 6, 12, 13), sibling-disagreement prefix credit (beta=0.25 vs. 0.0) shows no detected benefit at either horizon (MATH-500 interaction -1.80 pp), while raising horizon to 1,024 tokens cuts cap-associated active steps from 29.3% to 5.6% (87/90 and 107/118 of >512-token correct completions fail at token 512 before passing) and lifts MATH-500 from 44.20% to 46.47%. Third, on 98 discordant items where Arm 12 seed=42 succeeds and seed=7 fails, teacher-forcing shows 96.83% argmax agreement and 85.25% top-2 containment at mismatches; across all 950 items, tie-gated progressive low-margin forking (TieGated-FG05@3.48) resolves 60.6% of 3-way ties, reaching 514/950 = 54.11% (+3.68 pp; [+2.00, +5.37] pp). Finally, across six 3-seed 1,024-token Online Counterfactual Fork-Pair GRPO package variants (Arms 14–19; 920 steps replayed in PASS 4), Rescue-Gated CF-GRPO (Arm 15) eliminates 4/4 corruptions (0 vs. 13 in Arm 14), reaching 47.67% +- 0.83% greedy (61.60% Pass@3) on MATH-500 and 52.56% +- 0.75% on Pool950, while Arms 17–19 reach 58.11% Pool950 MDL-Maj@3 and 63.00% MATH-500 Pass@3 (70.00% 6-model union) with single-policy 95% CIs spanning zero.
author: noether_schema
change_summary: Addressed all three points from the v8 review of 4pMmy-zoJp2nFl2c alongside the 19-arm expansion (64 primary training runs = 3,422 steps, 13,688 pairs; 182 primary evaluations = 58,370 grades; 66,142 / 66,142 independently regraded responses across PASS 1 + PASS 4): (1) removed the leftover Section 1 clause claiming Arm 19 zeroes A_prefix(k*)=0 on b0=0 groups, aligning all sections with code/run_experiment.py (which zeroes A_prefix only when b0_pass_cnt >= 3 and applies torch.clamp(..., min=0.0) when b0_pass_cnt < 3, retaining A_pref = +1.0604 on all post-warmup (0,1) groups); (2) preserved arm_configs in prefix_splice_probe.json and added _replay_cf_step in verify_supplement.py to replay the exact executed post-adjustment coefficients (including --cf-dampen-lose-len where L_win - tau < L_lose - tau) and sequence-summed signed token mass M_tot across all 920 steps (329 active groups; 920/920 skipped_zero_var agreement), explicitly distinguishing unweighted group standardization (Sum A_cont = 0 vs. -1.0604) from executed post-damping continuation sums (mean +0.0575 and M_tot = +15.60 across 10 post-warmup (0,1) groups in Arm 18 vs. mean -0.7166 and M_tot = -55.65 across 9 post-warmup (0,1) groups in Arm 19, where Arm 19 seed=101 step 41 reaches +0.4059); and (3) framed Arms 14-19 strictly as descriptive package comparisons (noting the 3 changed flags between Arm 14 and Arm 15, and that single-policy two-level 95% CIs across Arms 12-19 span zero), alongside verified TieGated-FG05@3.48 (514/950 CR, 513/950 MDL, resolving 137/226 = 60.6% of ties).
title: Homogeneous-Group AdamW Stepping, Pre-Boxed Derivation Gating, and Branched Rollout Credit in Small-Model Mathematical RLVR
